vqa2.selection_reason: Official repository release announcement explicitly recommends this unified enhanced model for both image/video quality scoring; UGC/Streaming scorers primarily target video. Selection made before LLIE outcomes.

source_code_issues.endpoint_key_mismatch: wa5 reads high/low but caller stores excellent/bad in defaultdict(float). Use the published five-token equation directly; save source-key-defect scalar only as diagnostic.
source_code_issues.weight_scale: Released source weights [1,.8,.6,.4,.2] are a positive affine transform: code_score=0.8*paper_score+0.2 after endpoint-key reconciliation. Rank metrics/ties unaffected.
source_code_issues.hardware: CPU map for slowfast initialization; eager attention; half precision; offload-aware vision execution device; legacy torchvision functional_tensor import alias. No model parameter/value/prompt changes.

vital.selection_reason: Official paper section 4.2 evaluates VITAL-Base-8B for image/video scalar scoring; Assistant-8B is post-trained for text generation. Select the main scoring model rather than smaller transfer variants.

source_code_issues.README_routing: README names scoring.py which is absent in current tree. The actual evaluate_image.sh routes to internvl_chat_finetune.py. rating.py is not that route and uses last position instead of -3.
source_code_issues.weight_scale: Image evaluation entry uses [1,.8,.6,.4,.2], a positive affine transform of paper weights; no rank metric differences.
source_code_issues.initialization: Initialize SlowFast structure without re-downloading its pretrained weights; require exact full-checkpoint key coverage before scoring.
source_code_issues.hardware: No FlashAttention or bf16; eager float16, optional auto CPU offload.

license.code_root: No root license file detected; InternVL source files carry MIT headers.

common.scoring: One deterministic forward pass, selected five logits, float64 softmax and weighted mean; no token sampling or generation.
